mapper.sql: WHERE U.ROLE_CODE = 'ROLE_USER' AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS_CODE <> 'WITHDRAWN' AND U.WORKER_TYPE_CODE IS NOT NULL AND U.BIRTH_YEAR IS NOT NULL
(SELECT USER_ID, MAX(BASE_MONTH) AS BASE_MONTH FROM USER_INCOME_MONTH GROUP BY USER_ID) M
mapper.select:
SELECT U.USER_ID, U.WORKER_TYPE_CODE, U.BIRTH_YEAR, M.BASE_MONTH, D.REQUIRED_INCOME_MONTHS, A.TOTAL_ASSET_AMT, CASE WHEN L.BALANCE_SUM IS NOT NULL THEN L.BALANCE_SUM WHEN A.NO_LOAN_YN = 'Y' THEN 0 END AS TOTAL_DEBT_AMT FROM APP_USER U JOIN ON M.USER_ID = U.USER_ID JOIN DIM_WORKER_TYPE D ON D.WORKER_TYPE_CODE = U.WORKER_TYPE_CODE LEFT JOIN USER_ASSET_SNAPSHOT A ON A.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND A.BASE_MONTH = M.BASE_MONTH LEFT JOIN (SELECT USER_ID, BASE_MONTH, SUM(BALANCE_AMT) AS BALANCE_SUM FROM USER_LOAN GROUP BY USER_ID, BASE_MONTH) L ON L.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND L.BASE_MONTH = M.BASE_MONTH
ORDER BY U.USER_ID

SELECT I.USER_ID, I.BASE_MONTH, I.INCOME_AMT FROM USER_INCOME_MONTH I JOIN APP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = I.USER_ID JOIN ON M.USER_ID = I.USER_ID
AND I.BASE_MONTH >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(M.BASE_MONTH, 'YYYY-MM'), -11), 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY I.USER_ID, I.BASE_MONTH
